# FAA Aircraft Characteristics Database excerpt (public domain)

`faa_acd_excerpt.xlsx`: unmodified rows (ICAO A320, A321, B738, B77L, B744, A332) of the `ACD_Data`
sheet of the FAA Aircraft Characteristics Database
(https://www.faa.gov/airports/engineering/aircraft_char_database, file last modified 2025-01-03,
retrieved 2026-10-16). U.S. Government work. Used only by offline tests.
